title: Close SOTA epic after gates
description:
Run final gates and transition the SOTA epic when all child stories are complete.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] All child stories are done and required gates pass.
- [hard] All epic-blocking conditions are satisfied so the epic can be marked done once this task transitions and the downstream `01ae4c20` (publish closure report) closes. Direct ordering: `8f3fdc34` (this task) → `01ae4c20` (publish report) → epic `97bf0879` marked done. The epic-done transition itself is performed by the lead at the end of the cascade, not by this task; this task's role is to verify the gate-pass state across child stories so the cascade can fire.

## Note on amendment

The original SC#2 read "The epic is marked done and can serve as the b117c95e checkpoint." but the JIT graph has `01ae4c20` blocking the epic close, and `01ae4c20` itself blocked on `8f3fdc34` — a circular requirement that prevents this task from passing review. User-approved amendment 2026-05-08 (Wave-12 close-cascade unblock): SC#2 now requires only that the conditions for epic close are satisfied; the actual mark-done is performed at the end of the cascade.
